Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Action Dispatch & Correlation System
Content:
The action dispatch and correlation system connects the C# planner to the Node.js Mineflayer adapter through a fire-and-forget dispatch model with asynchronous event-driven completion.

## Architecture

AgentBackgroundService.DispatchActionsAsync (line 1831) dequeues ActionData from _queue, assigns a correlationId (Guid), creates a PendingAction(Dispatched) in _correlatedActions, and calls toolCaller.CallWithOutcomeAsync. The tool sends the action via WebSocket to the Node.js adapter. When the adapter completes the action, it emits an event (e.g., blockMined, moveComplete) back to C#. ProcessEventsAsync (line 687) routes the event to CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool or FailCorrelatedActionByTool.

## Correlation Lifecycle

1. ENQUEUE: ActionData created with optional correlationId (assigned if empty)
2. DISPATCHED: PendingAction(Dispatched) inserted into _correlatedActions via TryAdd
3. IN-FLIGHT: Action sent to Mineflayer via WebSocketBridge.SendActionAsync
4. COMPLETED: Adapter emits event → ProcessEventsAsync routes to CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool(toolName) → CAS TryUpdate transitions Dispatched→Completed
5. FAILED: Adapter emits error → FailCorrelatedActionByTool → CAS transitions Dispatched→Failed
6. TIMED OUT: SweepTimedOutActions (line 2754) finds Dispatched actions older than per-tool timeout → CAS transitions Dispatched→TimedOut

## Per-Tool Timeout Overrides

DefaultActionTimeoutSeconds = 30. Overrides in ToolTimeoutOverrides (IReadOnlyDictionary):
- "place" = 15s (Sprint 56 TSK-0270: increased from 5s — pathfinding round-trip)
- "GetStatus" / "Status" = 10s (Sprint 54 TSK-0221: avoid blocking stale-inventory guard)
- "MoveTo" = 10s
- "Wander" = 15s
- "mine" = 15s (Sprint 58 Wave D TSK-0332: fail fast on blocked blocks)
- "SmeltItem" = 45s (Sprint 44 council: must exceed JS adapter SMELT_TIMEOUT_MS=40s)
- All others = 30s default

## PlaceBlock-Specific Correlation (_placeBlockContexts)

- Sprint 42 (TSK-0075): ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, (string BlueprintId, int BlockIndex)> stores blueprint context per PlaceBlock correlationId (line 203 declaration, cleared at lines ~340, ~410)
- BlockPlacedEvent handler uses _placeBlockContexts to advance the build checkpoint
- Auto-skip after 3 consecutive timeouts (Sprint 54 TSK-0226): _blockTimeoutCounts tracks per-block-index counts; MaxConsecutivePlaceTimeouts=3 triggers SetBlockStatus(BlockStatusSkipped) + fact recording
- Sprint 44 P1-2: stale _placeBlockContexts entries (orphaned after _correlatedActions removal) are cleaned up in SweepTimedOutActions
- Block timeout count cleared on successful place, preventing accumulation across unrelated build sessions

## GetStatus Timeout Escalation

- _consecutiveGetStatusTimeouts: after 2 consecutive timeouts, clears IsInventoryStale to prevent indefinite blocking on unresponsive adapter (Sprint 54 TSK-0221)

## Fire-and-Forget Concurrency Limits

- MaxConcurrentForTool (line 2689): PlaceBlock = _maxConcurrentPlaceBlock (default 8, configurable via DI), all others = 1
- IsFireAndForgetTool: MineBlock, place, CraftItem, SmeltItem — tools whose ActionOutcome.Effects may be empty; concurrency gates prevent queue pileup
- PendingCountOfTool() checks _correlatedActions for actions with matching tool name in Dispatched state

## Synchronization: CAS Loop

_correlatedActions is a ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, PendingAction>. State transitions use TryUpdate with the expected old value to prevent race conditions between timeout sweep and result events. All state transitions (Dispatched→Completed, Dispatched→Failed, Dispatched→TimedOut) are CAS-based.

## ActionOutcome Accumulation

_cycleOutcomes: ConcurrentQueue<ActionOutcome> accumulates per-cycle outcomes for ILlmEvaluator (Sprint 38 P3 / Sprint 39). Cleared on new plan generation or new goal. The LLM evaluator consumes ActionOutcome[] for observation-driven replanning.

## Pre-Dispatch World State Snapshot

- _preDispatchSnapshot: WorldState captured before each action dispatch (Sprint 55 TSK-0155)
- _worldModel.Predict() enriches WorldStateDiff with expected gains/losses for fire-and-forget tools (Sprint 58 TSK-0309)
- Used by observe→compare→evaluate replan loop

## SweepTimedOutActions Details (line 2754)

- Iterates all _correlatedActions entries
- For each Dispatched action: checks if elapsed time exceeds per-tool timeout (GetActionTimeoutSeconds)
- Transitions to TimedOut, logs warning with tool name, correlationId, and elapsed time
- Late events after timeout: handled by CAS check — if already TimedOut, CompleteCorrelatedActionByTool will fail the TryUpdate (expected old value is Dispatched)
- _placeBlockContexts entries for timed-out PlaceBlock are preserved to handle late BlockPlacedEvents (TSK-0128)
- Stale _placeBlockContexts for non-place tools cleaned up per Sprint 44 P1-2
